literal: Xingzong, Part Two
idiomatic: Xingzong, Part Two

literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on the xinhai new moon, Song dispatched Liang Shi, Zhang Congyi, Fu Bi, and Zhao Rixuan to come congratulate.
idiomatic: In the tenth year, on the xinhai new moon of the first spring month Song sent Liang Shi, Zhang Congyi, Fu Bi, and Zhao Rixuan with congratulations.

literal: On jiazi day, again dispatched Wu Yu and Feng Dai to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Wu Yu and Feng Dai were again dispatched to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

literal: Second month, on the gengchen new moon, edict ordered households of the Pulu Modu tribe who had returned to Yasus Guan and been confiscated to resume their occupations.
idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the second month an edict ordered households of the Pulu Modu tribe who had returned to Yasus Guan and been confiscated to resume their occupations.

literal: On jiashen day, Northern Privy Council reported that attendants of the Southern and Northern Princes' palaces and various tribal military commissioners all came from tribal tents; since they were exempted from border garrison service along with commoners, it requested that attendant duties also be permitted to be performed by retainers in their stead.
idiomatic: On jiashen day the Northern Privy Council reported that attendants of the Southern and Northern Princes' palaces and various tribal military commissioners all came from tribal tents; since they were exempted from border garrison service along with commoners, it requested that attendant duties also be permitted to be performed by retainers in their stead.

literal: Edict approved the request.
idiomatic: An edict approved the request.

literal: In summer, fourth month, edict abolished the work of building the Yalü River pontoon bridge and Han troops' border garrison service.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month an edict abolished the work of building the Yalü River pontoon bridge and Han troops' border garrison service.

literal: Also, because Eastern Capital regent Xiao Saba memorialized, lifted the ban on cuju in the Eastern Capital.
idiomatic: Also, because Eastern Capital regent Xiao Saba memorialized, the ban on cuju in the Eastern Capital was lifted.

literal: Sixth month, on the wuyin new moon, appointed Xiao Ning, Yelü Tan, Cui Yucheng, Ma Shiliang, Yelü Renxian, and Liu Liufu chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays;
idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the sixth month Xiao Ning, Yelü Tan, Cui Yucheng, Ma Shiliang, Yelü Renxian, and Liu Liufu were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays;

literal: Yelü Shucheng, Zhao Cheng, Yelü Lie, and Zhang Dan chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.
idiomatic: Yelü Shucheng, Zhao Cheng, Yelü Lie, and Zhang Dan were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renxu day, edict ordered that officials who privately took government goods be judged as common theft.
idiomatic: On renxu day of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered that officials who privately took government goods be judged as common theft.

literal: Whoever dared to bring lawsuits citing cases already decided in former reigns was to be punished.
idiomatic: Whoever dared to bring lawsuits citing cases already decided in former reigns was to be punished.

literal: Attendant langjun who hunted deer in forbidden grounds received three hundred strokes and were not assessed compensation;
idiomatic: Attendant langjun who hunted deer in forbidden grounds received three hundred strokes and were not assessed compensation;

literal: lesser generals received two hundred strokes or less;
idiomatic: lesser generals received two hundred strokes or less;

literal: and commoners who violated were punished on the same terms as langjun.
idiomatic: and commoners who violated were punished on the same terms as langjun.

literal: Eighth month, on bingxu day, because physician Deng Yanzhen's treatment of xiangwen Xiao Liuning's illness proved effective, his parents were granted official rank as reward.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the eighth month, because physician Deng Yanzhen's treatment of xiangwen Xiao Liuning's illness proved effective, his parents were granted official rank as reward.

literal: Ninth month, on xinhai day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On xinhai day of the ninth month the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

literal: Imperial maternal uncle Liuning died.
idiomatic: Imperial maternal uncle Liuning died.

literal: On gengshen day, the Empress Dowager shot and captured a bear; the Emperor offered wine to wish her long life.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the Empress Dowager shot and captured a bear, and the Emperor offered wine to wish her long life.

literal: On guihai day, the Emperor hunted at Ma Meng Mountain; vegetation was thick and dense, fearing hunters might accidentally shoot and injure people, he ordered Yelü Digu and the others each to write their names on their arrows for identification.
idiomatic: On guihai day the Emperor hunted at Ma Meng Mountain; vegetation was thick and dense, and fearing hunters might accidentally shoot and injure people, he ordered Yelü Digu and the others each to write their names on their arrows for identification.

literal: On bingyin day, Xia State presented Song captives.
idiomatic: On bingyin day Xia State presented Song captives.

literal: Because Shiying Stockade grand preceptor Guo San avoided a tiger and did not shoot, he was dismissed from office.
idiomatic: Because Shiying Stockade grand preceptor Guo San avoided a tiger and did not shoot, he was dismissed from office.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingxu day, edict ordered Eastern Capital regent Xiao Xiaozhong to investigate officials who were incorruptible, capable, pure, and forceful, and report their names in full.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the tenth winter month an edict ordered Eastern Capital regent Xiao Xiaozhong to investigate officials who were incorruptible, capable, pure, and forceful, and report their names in full.

literal: On gengyin day, made Jurchen grand preceptor Taiya Great King of Yasus Guan.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Jurchen grand preceptor Taiya was made Great King of Yasus Guan.

literal: On xinmao day, because the imperial prince Hulu Woli was born, Northern Chancellor and imperial son-in-law Saba Ning welcomed the Emperor to his residence for feasting and drinking; the Emperor ordered guards and Han people to wrestle for amusement.
idiomatic: On xinmao day, because the imperial prince Hulu Woli was born, Northern Chancellor and imperial son-in-law Saba Ning welcomed the Emperor to his residence for feasting and drinking; the Emperor ordered guards and Han people to wrestle for amusement.

literal: On renchen day, drank again in the Empress Dowager's hall; because an imperial prince was born, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: On renchen day the court drank again in the Empress Dowager's hall; because an imperial prince had been born, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: In the evening, summoned princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and inner-chamber ministers into the sleeping hall for heavy drinking again.
idiomatic: In the evening princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and inner-chamber ministers were summoned into the sleeping hall for heavy drinking again.

literal: On jiawu day, visited the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the court visited the Central Capital.

literal: On gengzi day, made imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Hulie imperial maternal uncle xiangwen.
idiomatic: On gengzi day imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Hulie was appointed imperial maternal uncle xiangwen.

literal: Eleventh month, on bingchen day, Uighur dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingchen day of the eleventh month Uighur sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Twelfth month, on the bingzi new moon, Song dispatched Liu Hong and Wang Zheng to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.
idiomatic: On the bingzi new moon of the twelfth month Song sent Liu Hong and Wang Zheng to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.

literal: On yiwei day, established chiefs for the Tazhubu Gu tribe.
idiomatic: On yiwei day chiefs were established for the Tazhubu Gu tribe.

literal: Made Hu Talaci Associate Councilor of State.
idiomatic: Hu Talaci was appointed Associate Councilor of State.

literal: The Emperor heard that Song had fortified the passes and rivers and dug moats, fearing it would become a border threat; with Southern and Northern Privy Commissioners Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu and Prince of Zhao Xiao Guanning he plotted to recover the ten Song counties south of the passes ceded in former times, and thereupon dispatched Xiao Ying and Liu Liufu as envoys to Song.
idiomatic: The Emperor heard that Song had fortified the passes and rivers and dug moats and feared it would become a border threat; with Southern and Northern Privy Commissioners Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu and Prince of Zhao Xiao Guanning he plotted to recover the ten Song counties south of the passes ceded in former times, and thereupon dispatched Xiao Ying and Liu Liufu as envoys to Song.

literal: On gengyin day, Song dispatched Zhang Mian, Hou Zongliang, Xue Shen, Shi Qijun, Shi Changyan, and Pan Yongzhao to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival and New Year's Day of the coming year.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Song sent Zhang Mian, Hou Zongliang, Xue Shen, Shi Qijun, Shi Changyan, and Pan Yongzhao to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival and New Year's Day of the coming year.

literal: Made Xuanzheng Hall academician Yang Jie Minister of Personnel and administrator of Shunyi Army military commissioner affairs.
idiomatic: Xuanzheng Hall academician Yang Jie was appointed Minister of Personnel and administrator of Shunyi Army military commissioner affairs.

literal: On dingyou day, discussed attacking Song; edict ordered proclamation to all routes.
idiomatic: On dingyou day an attack on Song was discussed, and an edict ordered proclamation to all routes.

literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, on wushen day, escorted the Empress Dowager into the inner hall.
idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on wushen day of the first spring month the Empress Dowager was escorted into the inner hall.

literal: On gengxu day, dispatched Southern Court commissioner of the palace secretariat Xiao Teme and Hanlin Academician Liu Liufu as envoys to Song to recover the ten counties south of Jinyang and Waqiao;
idiomatic: On gengxu day Southern Court commissioner of the palace secretariat Xiao Teme and Hanlin Academician Liu Liufu were dispatched as envoys to Song to recover the ten counties south of Jinyang and Waqiao;

literal: and also to inquire into the reasons for mobilizing troops against Xia and dredging border marshes and increasing military garrisons.
idiomatic: and also to inquire into the reasons for mobilizing troops against Xia and dredging border marshes and increasing military garrisons.

literal: Second month, on renyin day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
idiomatic: On renyin day of the second month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on the jiaxu new moon, promulgated reward-and-punishment regulations for the southern campaign.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the fourth summer month reward-and-punishment regulations for the southern campaign were promulgated.

literal: Sixth month, on yihai day, Song dispatched Fu Bi and Zhang Maoshi bearing letters on a goodwill mission; replied with a letter.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the sixth month Song sent Fu Bi and Zhang Maoshi bearing letters on a goodwill mission, and a letter was sent in reply.

literal: On renwu day, presided at Hailiang Hall and released jinshi Wang Shi and sixty-four others.
idiomatic: On renwu day the court presided at Hailiang Hall and released jinshi Wang Shi and sixty-four others.

literal: Forbade the sale of felt and silver into Song.
idiomatic: The sale of felt and silver into Song was forbidden.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the renyin new moon, edict ordered that those who stole or swapped official horses receive reduced death sentences.
idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered that those who stole or swapped official horses receive reduced death sentences.

literal: Outside-route officials who were diligent and upright were replaced at term's end;
idiomatic: Outside-route officials who were diligent and upright were replaced at term's end;

literal: those who did not handle affairs were replaced immediately.
idiomatic: those who did not handle affairs were replaced immediately.

literal: Eighth month, on bingshen day, Song again dispatched Fu Bi and Zhang Maoshi bearing letters on a goodwill mission, requesting increased annual tribute in silver and silk; replied with a letter.
idiomatic: On bingshen day of the eighth month Song again sent Fu Bi and Zhang Maoshi bearing letters on a goodwill mission, requesting increased annual tribute in silver and silk, and a letter was sent in reply.

literal: Ninth month, on renyin day, dispatched Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian and Han traveling palace deputy deployment director Liu Liufu as envoys to Song to negotiate peace.
idiomatic: On renyin day of the ninth month Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian and Han traveling palace deputy deployment director Liu Liufu were dispatched as envoys to Song to negotiate peace.

literal: At that time Fu Bi spoke to the Emperor, the general purport being that if Liao made peace with Song and passively received annual tribute, the benefit lay with the state and subordinates had no share;
idiomatic: At that time Fu Bi spoke to the Emperor, the general purport being that if Liao made peace with Song and passively received annual tribute, the benefit lay with the state and subordinates had no share;

literal: if Liao fought Song, the benefit lay with subordinates and the harm with the state.
idiomatic: if Liao fought Song, the benefit lay with subordinates and the harm with the state.

literal: The Emperor was moved by his words, and friendly relations were finally settled.
idiomatic: The Emperor was moved by his words, and friendly relations were finally settled.

literal: Intercalary month, on guiwei day, Yelü Renxian dispatched a messenger reporting that Song's annual tribute was increased by one hundred thousand taels of silver and bolts of silk, the documents called it tribute, delivered to Baigou;
idiomatic: On guiwei day of the intercalary month Yelü Renxian dispatched a messenger reporting that Song's annual tribute was increased by one hundred thousand taels of silver and bolts of silk, the documents called it tribute, and it was delivered to Baigou;

literal: the Emperor was pleased and feasted ministers at Zhaozing Hall.
idiomatic: the Emperor was pleased and feasted ministers at Zhaozing Hall.

literal: That day, relief was provided for the poor among the three paternal clans.
idiomatic: That day relief was provided for the poor among the three paternal clans.

literal: On xinmao day, Renxian and Liu Liufu returned and presented the Song State oath document.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Renxian and Liu Liufu returned and presented the Song State oath document.

literal: Winter, eleventh month, on dinghai day, ministers added the honorific title Sagacious Cultured, Sagacious Martial, Heroic Strategist, Divine Merit, Wise Sage, Benevolent Filial Emperor, and invested Empress Xiao as Chaste Virtuous, Proclaiming Benevolence, Exalted Sage Empress.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the eleventh winter month ministers added the honorific title Sagacious Cultured, Sagacious Martial, Heroic Strategist, Divine Merit, Wise Sage, Benevolent Filial Emperor, and invested Empress Xiao as Chaste Virtuous, Proclaiming Benevolence, Exalted Sage Empress.

literal: General amnesty.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: Prince of Liang Hongji was advanced to Prince of Yan.
idiomatic: Prince of Liang Hongji was advanced to Prince of Yan.

literal: Twelfth month, on guimao day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the twelfth month the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

literal: On jiachen day, enfeoffed Imperial Grand Younger Brother Chongyuan's son Nielugu as Duke of Anding Commandery.
idiomatic: On jiachen day Imperial Grand Younger Brother Chongyuan's son Nielugu was enfeoffed as Duke of Anding Commandery.

literal: On jiyou day, because it was Empress Xuanxian's death anniversary, the Emperor and Empress Dowager wore plain dress and fed monks at Yanshou, Minzhong, and Sanxue temples.
idiomatic: On jiyou day, because it was Empress Xuanxian's death anniversary, the Emperor and Empress Dowager wore plain dress and fed monks at Yanshou, Minzhong, and Sanxue temples.

literal: On xinhai day, edict remitted one year's rent and tax for tribes that had prepared to attack Song.
idiomatic: On xinhai day an edict remitted one year's rent and tax for tribes that had prepared to attack Song.

literal: On renzi day, because the Tuyuhun and Tangut frequently sold horses to Xia State, edict ordered strict border defense.
idiomatic: On renzi day, because the Tuyuhun and Tangut frequently sold horses to Xia State, an edict ordered strict border defense.

literal: On jiwei day, Song envoys congratulating on New Year's Day and the Eternal Longevity Festival were staying at their lodgings; the Emperor went in disguise to observe them.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Song envoys congratulating on New Year's Day and the Eternal Longevity Festival were staying at their lodgings, and the Emperor went in disguise to observe them.

literal: On dingmao day, forbade killing cattle and horses at funerals and hoarding precious treasures.
idiomatic: On dingmao day killing cattle and horses at funerals and hoarding precious treasures were forbidden.

literal: Twelfth year, spring, first month, on xinwei day, dispatched Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song.
idiomatic: In the twelfth year, on xinwei day of the first spring month Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji were dispatched to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song.

literal: On renshen day, made Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu Southern Privy Commissioner, Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaozhong Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Chu, Prince of Han Xiao Hui Northern Chancellor and co-administrator of the marshal headquarters, Han Ba Southern Court great king, Yelü Houshen Eastern Capital regent, Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian co-administrator of Eastern Capital regent affairs, Northern Court linya Xiao Ge Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.
idiomatic: On renshen day Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Southern Privy Commissioner; Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaozhong was made Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Chu; Prince of Han Xiao Hui was made Northern Chancellor and co-administrator of the marshal headquarters; Han Ba was made Southern Court great king; Yelü Houshen was appointed Eastern Capital regent; Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian was made co-administrator of Eastern Capital regent affairs; and Northern Court linya Xiao Ge was appointed Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.

literal: On jiaxu day, went to Wuqing Stockade Reed Marsh.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day the court went to Wuqing Stockade Reed Marsh.

literal: Second month, on renyin day, forbade Han commoners south of the passes from possessing bows and arrows.
idiomatic: On renyin day of the second month Han commoners south of the passes were forbidden from possessing bows and arrows.

literal: On jiyou day, Xia State, because of the added honorific title, dispatched envoys to congratulate.
idiomatic: On jiyou day Xia State, because of the added honorific title, sent envoys to congratulate.

literal: On jiayin day, Yelü Dilie and others returned from their mission to Xia State and reported that Yuanhao had ceased hostilities; envoys were immediately dispatched to inform Song.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Yelü Dilie and others returned from their mission to Xia State and reported that Yuanhao had ceased hostilities; envoys were immediately dispatched to inform Song.

literal: Third month, on xinmao day, visited the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: On xinmao day of the third month the court visited the Southern Capital.

literal: On renchen day, Goryeo, because of the added honorific title, dispatched envoys to congratulate.
idiomatic: On renchen day Goryeo, because of the added honorific title, sent envoys to congratulate.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on jihai day, established xiangwen and chief superintendent for the Huiba tribe.
idiomatic: On jihai day of the fourth summer month xiangwen and chief superintendent were established for the Huiba tribe.

literal: On gengzi day, Xia State dispatched envoys presenting horses and camels.
idiomatic: On gengzi day Xia State sent envoys presenting horses and camels.

literal: Fifth month, on xinmao day, two envoys of the Wolu and Pulu Modu tribes came with tribute late; they were pardoned and sent back.
idiomatic: On xinmao day of the fifth month two envoys of the Wolu and Pulu Modu tribes came with tribute late; they were pardoned and sent back.

literal: On yiwei day, edict restored and fixed the ritual regulations.
idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict restored and fixed the ritual regulations.

literal: That month, visited western mountains.
idiomatic: That month the court visited the western mountains.

literal: Sixth month, on bingwu day, edict ordered that families of imperial-select chancellors and military commissioners and those who were themselves military commissioners be permitted burial goods of silver;
idiomatic: On bingwu day of the sixth month an edict ordered that families of imperial-select chancellors and military commissioners and those who were themselves military commissioners be permitted burial goods of silver;

literal: still forbade slaughtering livestock for sacrifice.
idiomatic: slaughtering livestock for sacrifice was still forbidden.

literal: On gengxu day, edict ordered that when Han palace allotment households died out, fixed property was to pass to relatives.
idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict ordered that when Han palace allotment households died out, fixed property was to pass to relatives.

literal: On xinhai day, Zubu great king Tuntu Gusi's younger brother Grand Commandant Sage Li came to court.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Zubu great king Tuntu Gusi's younger brother Grand Commandant Sage Li came to court.

literal: On bingchen day, Uighur dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Uighur sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jiazi day, made Southern Privy Commissioner Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu Northern Privy Commissioner and transferred enfeoffment to Prince of Qi.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Southern Privy Commissioner Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Northern Privy Commissioner and transferred in enfeoffment to Prince of Qi.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the bingyin new moon, Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaozhong died; prisoners in custody were specially released.
idiomatic: On the bingyin new moon of the seventh autumn month Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaozhong died, and prisoners in custody were specially released.

literal: On gengyin day, Xia State dispatched envoys with a memorial requesting to attack Song; not approved.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Xia State sent envoys with a memorial requesting to attack Song; approval was not granted.

literal: Eighth month, on bingshen day, visited Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On bingshen day of the eighth month the court visited Qing Mausoleum.

literal: On xin day, Prince of Yan Hongji was additionally made Director of the Department of State Affairs, administering Northern and Southern Privy Commissioner affairs, and advanced to Prince of Yan and Zhao.
idiomatic: On xin day Prince of Yan Hongji was additionally made Director of the Department of State Affairs, administering Northern and Southern Privy Commissioner affairs, and advanced to Prince of Yan and Zhao.

literal: On wuwu day, made former Northwest Route campaign commissioner Xiao Taliege Right yilibi.
idiomatic: On wuwu day former Northwest Route campaign commissioner Xiao Taliege was appointed Right yilibi.

literal: On gengshen day, yueye Yelü Honggu died.
idiomatic: On gengshen day yueye Yelü Honggu died.

literal: On jiazi day, Zubu came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Zubu came with tribute.

literal: Ninth month, on renshen day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager and visited Wangxian Hall.
idiomatic: On renshen day of the ninth month the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager and visited Wangxian Hall.

literal: On renwu day, visited Huai Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On renwu day the court visited Huai Mausoleum.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingyou day, encamped at Zhonghui River.
idiomatic: On dingyou day of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Zhonghui River.

literal: On jihai day, Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaomu died; posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Chancellor and Prince of Jin.
idiomatic: On jihai day Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaomu died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Chancellor and Prince of Jin.

literal: On gengzi day, edict ordered serious prisoners on all routes to have officials conduct detailed review.
idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict ordered serious prisoners on all routes to have officials conduct detailed review.

literal: On xinhai day, Associate Councilor Han Shaofang was made Guangde Army military commissioner, and Three Departments commissioner Liu Liufu Changning Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Associate Councilor Han Shaofang was appointed Guangde Army military commissioner, and Three Departments commissioner Liu Liufu was appointed Changning Army military commissioner.

literal: On renzi day, because Xia people had encroached on the Tangut, dispatched Yanchang Palace envoy Gao Jianu to rebuke them.
idiomatic: On renzi day, because Xia people had encroached on the Tangut, Yanchang Palace envoy Gao Jianu was dispatched to rebuke them.
